newsitem.title: GERMANY: Frankfurt bourse seen headed higher still.
newsitem.headline: Frankfurt bourse seen headed higher still.

text.p: German shares were expected to maintain their record-breaking run on Thursday despite a fall on Wall Street overnight.
The IBIS DAX, which reflects all-day computer trade in the DAX index, was up 7.78 points at 3,827.30 in morning trade after hitting a new record-high of 3,826.10 after the open.

General shareholder meetings at Deutsche Telekom AG and Lufthansa punctuated early trade. Telekom said it had struck a preliminary interconnection with Viag Interkom GmbH and that it expected higher 1997 domestic sales. Telekom shares were down 15 pfennigs to 42.63.
Lufthansa was down 30 pfennigs at 35 marks.
The big mover of the day was industrial giant Daimler-Benz AG, which surged on news that it plans to sell its stake in computer systems firm Cap Gemini SA.
The share was trading up 5.70 marks at 142.70 marks.
Bank stocks were generally weaker as investors took profits following strong gains in the sector.
Deutsche Bank AG, a clear outperformer in recent days, was down one mark at 103.30 marks.
